items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And it was nice working with her.

ctx.x: I just said Pearl Bailey was the vocalist with the Cootie Williams band, and that was before she become a big star. Most people didn't even know that she could sing. She was also a dancer, too. And it was nice working with her. She was the only woman with the band. There's really nothing too much to say.

The big vocal star in Cootie's band was Eddie Vinson. He was the big vocal star. He'd come into New York and be(?) layin' low. Pearl would be making records with Sinatra and different vocalists downtown. Her and Hot Lips Page made a record, "Baby, It's Cold Outside," and I think that's the one that started her off in the right direction. That record was Hot Lips Page, "Baby It's Cold Outside." And after that, she never looked back! She just turned out one record after another, and next thing I know she was a big…
